blocks.text: A responsive image can shrink to fit its parent while keeping its shape. Auto height keeps the original width-to-height ratio.
Use the runnable HTML examples here, then resize a local browser page or its device preview. The CSS examples are inside each small page, so no framework is required.

blocks.code: In your project, apply this rule to a real image with width and height attributes.
blocks.title: Let pictures shrink

blocks.text: Read the code step by step

items: `max-width: 100%` stops the image or box growing wider than its available parent width.
`height: auto` lets the height follow the image's shape when its width changes.

blocks.text: Images using this rule stay within their parent width. Their shape is kept instead of being stretched.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: Do not set an unrelated fixed height and width if that would squash the picture.

blocks.title: Your small task
blocks.text: Apply the rule to a local photo and narrow the window.
